gloss: just after a bath; fresh from the bath

definitions.gloss: just after a bath; fresh from the bath
definitions.explanation: The state or moment immediately after getting out of a bath or hot spring. Also used as a modifier for things used or done right after bathing.

examples.japanese: {湯上|ゆあ}がりのビールは{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: A beer right after a bath is the best.

examples.japanese: {湯上|ゆあ}がりに{冷|つめ}たい{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}を{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: I drank cold milk right after the bath.

examples.japanese: {湯上|ゆあ}がりの{肌|はだ}は{乾燥|かんそう}しやすいので、すぐに{保湿|ほしつ}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: Skin right after a bath dries out easily, so it's best to moisturize right away.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}の{湯上|ゆあ}がりに{浴衣|ゆかた}を{着|き}て{旅館|りょかん}の{廊下|ろうか}を{歩|ある}くのは{気持|きも}ちがいい。
examples.english: It feels wonderful to walk through the ryokan hallway in a yukata after the hot spring.

notes:
Compound of {湯|ゆ} (hot water/bath) and {上|あ}がり (coming out of). Strongly associated with Japanese bathing culture — especially {温泉|おんせん} (hot springs) and {銭湯|せんとう} (public baths). The image of drinking cold milk or beer after a bath is a classic cultural reference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯上|ゆあ}がりタオル: bath towel (for after bathing)
- {湯上|ゆあ}がりの{肌|はだ}: skin fresh from the bath
- {湯上|ゆあ}がりに{飲|の}む: to drink right after bathing
- {湯上|ゆあ}がりの{一杯|いっぱい}: a drink right after the bath

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がり: after a bath — essentially synonymous, but {風呂上|ふろあ}がり is slightly more colloquial
- {入浴後|にゅうよくご}: after bathing — more formal and clinical

CULTURAL NOTE:
Drinking cold {牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう} (milk) in the changing room of a {銭湯|せんとう} after bathing is a beloved Japanese custom, often depicted in media.
